eval: dp.net.send({t: 'rules', reset: true}); 'rules reset to the defaults'

(() => { const v = () => document.getElementById('timeValue').textContent; const seen = [v()]; for (const id of ['timePlus', 'timeMinus', 'timeMinus']) { document.getElementById(id).click(); seen.push(dp.lobby.wanted.ROUND_TIME_LIMIT); } return JSON.stringify({shown: seen[0], askedFor: seen.slice(1)}); })()
(() => { for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) document.getElementById('timeMinus').click(); return 'round time down to the shortest steps'; })()

(() => { document.getElementById('rulesBtn').click(); const ed = dp.editor; ed.group = 'damage'; ed.renderNav(); ed.renderList(); ed.setDraft('HEALTH_REGEN', true); ed.setFocus('HEALTH_REGEN_RATE'); return [...document.querySelectorAll('#rulesList .rule')].filter((r) => r.dataset.key.startsWith('HEALTH_REGEN')).map((r) => r.dataset.key + '=' + r.querySelector('.value').textContent).join(', ') + ' | ' + document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent; })()

(() => { const ed = dp.editor; ed.replaceDraft({ ...ed.base() }); ed.group = 'teamhp'; ed.renderNav(); ed.renderList(); ed.setDraft('TEAM_HEALTH', true); ed.setDraft('TEAM_REGEN', true); ed.setFocus('TEAM_REGEN_CAP_SHARE'); return document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent; })()

dp.net.send({t: 'rules', set: {HEALTH_REGEN: true, HEALTH_REGEN_RATE: 12, HEALTH_REGEN_DELAY: 1.5, HEALTH_REGEN_CAP_SHARE: 70, HEALTH_REGEN_STILL: 'off', TEAM_REGEN_STILL: 'off', BOTS_RED: 0, BOTS_BLUE: 1, BOT_SKILL: 'easy', ROUND_TIME_LIMIT: 25}}); 'own health: +12/s after 1.5 s, up to 70%; one easy BLUE bot; 25 s rounds'
dp.net.send({t: 'rules', player: 'Bot Blitz', set: {BOT_EASY_AIM: 0, BOT_EASY_BANK: 0}}); 'Bot Blitz aims dead on, so every run gets hit'
